description: Update an existing custom object schema by its key.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

description.description: Human-readable description of the custom object

fields.description: Array of field definition objects for the schema

icon.description: Icon identifier for the custom object

labels.description: Label configuration object with singular and plural display names

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

primaryDisplayField.description: Field key used as the primary display value for records

schemaKey.description: Unique key identifying the custom object schema

searchableFields.description: Array of field keys that should be searchable

name: crm_update_object_schema
